'''Aesea''' was the name of a [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive that had a nest in the [[Southern Cliffs]] of the [[Glarus Valley]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], their [[Aesea Killik Hives|cave nest]] was breached and they expanded their hives out onto the cliffside.
